notes: I use eartips to match an IEM's character: if it needs brightness, pick a wide bore; if it's too bright or stinging, pick one that warms it up, like a narrower bore or foam. Eartips are like helmets: once you like one brand, you'll keep wearing it whatever bike you ride.
Foam follows the shape of your ear better, but for me it's less comfortable, cuts a lot of treble and makes the bass a little soft.

tips.name: Infitear ie45 pro
tips.review: Like the JVC Spiral Dot++, but not as flat/short, and the bore diameter isn't as wide as the JVC; it still has the dot pattern inside. What I hear: it keeps the sub-bass reasonably present rather than losing it like the JVC, and the top of the treble and the upper mids don't get shoutier. Very comfortable. Tested on the Xuan NV, Soratune Yi01 and Kinera Wyvern: all gained deep sub-bass, but not boosted. The treble is a touch warmer.
tips.original: Dia kaya JVC Spiral dot ++ tapi gak seceper/pendek itu. dan diameter lobangnya gak selebar JVC. tetep ada pola titik titik did alemnya. yang gw rasain dia ngejaga sub bass dengan cukup hadir gak sehilang di JVC. dan ujung treble dan uppermids yang gak jadi makin shouty juga. Kenyamanannya oke banget di test di Xuan nv, Soratune yi01, dan kinera wyvern, gw rasain improve semua sub bas dalem. tapi ga boosted. treble a touch warmer.
tips.usedWith: Tangzu Xuan Nv, Kinera Wyvern, Soratune Yi01, Mangird Tea Pro

tips.name: Acoustune AET08
tips.tagline: Discontinued; if you find it, it may be a KBEAR copy
tips.review: The strangest eartip: it claims to widen the lower mids, and it really does; I think it also adds a little punch. It can make a bright IEM a little warmer. I mostly use this and the Azla Sedna EarFit Light when I need to adjust brightness; those two are my go-tos. AET08's weakness: sometimes it doesn't stay on well on IEMs whose nozzles have no lip, the straight, smooth ones.
tips.original: Eartips paling aneh, dia ngeclaim bisa bikin bagian lower mid bisa jadi lebar. Dan benar aja. Eartips ini bikin kae gitu & gw rasa jg bikin punchy sedikit. Untuk arah suaranya bisa bikin IEM yang bright jadi agak warm sedikit. Mostly Gw pakai ini dan Azla Sedna Earfit Light  buat kalo butuh ngebikin bright nya. 2 itu lagi jadi andalan gw. Kekurangan AET08 adalah dia kadang gak nemplok dengan baik di beberapa IEM yang gak ada ujung sangkutannnya, alias yang lurus licin.

tips.name: Softears UC
tips.review: Medical-grade silicone. It preserves clarity and keeps the soundstage from getting congested. Pleasant, and suits IEMs with big shells too. The material feels a bit tacky, like Xelastec, but nice. The tube isn't as short as Xelastec's, a bit longer, so the soundstage stays fairly well preserved, though not as wide as AET08 and with less bass than AET08. Fairly neutral and clear. Good for people who want more clarity while keeping the soundstage.
tips.original: Medical Grade Silicone. dia ngejaga clarity. maintain soundstage gak terlalu congested. enak dan cocok buat IEM yang shellnya besar2 juga. rasanya emang kaya agak rekat/lengket2 materialnya kaya Xelastec. tapi enak. nozzlenya gak sependek si Xelastec agak lebi panjang makanya soundstagenya tetep agak kemaintain dgn baik lah. walau tidak selebar AET08, dan bassnya ga sebanyak aet08 tapi cukup netral jernih. cocok buat yang pengen nambah clarity dan maintain soundstage

tips.name: JVC Spiral Dot ++
tips.review: Expensive, but really cool. Although it's a bit short, it keeps the clarity and the soundstage, maybe because of the dots. Keep in mind it's the DOTS++, not the regular Dots. It also works on TWS like the Sony WF-1000XM4 and fits in the case really well.
tips.original: Ini emang mahal tapi keren banget. walau dia agak pendek. dia bisa maintain kejernihan dan juga soundstagenya. mungkin karena dotsnya itu. keep in mind yang DOTS ++ bukan DOTS biasa. dan bisa juga dipakain di TWS kaya SONY WF-1000xm4. dan muat di dalam casing nnya enak sekaliii

tips.name: JVC Spiral Dot Stress Free
tips.review: Available in ML and MS sizes if you need a more precise fit. Good upper midrange, slightly less treble. Very comfortable and light. The umbrella has a cut-away tail. Super comfortable and light; I thought the short umbrella would feel loose, but not at all. The space it gives is pleasant. "Less pressure on the ear", says the brand.
tips.original: Ada ukuran ML dan MS kalo butuh akurasi fitting lebih. Good upper midrange. Less treble dikit. nyaman banget. dan ringan. ada  kaya ekor yang dipotong di bagian payung eartipsnya. super nyaman dan ringan. gw pikir akan ada rasa melayangnya karena payung pendek. ternyata gak sama sekali. ruang yang diberikan jadi enak. Less Pressure to the ear ceunah brandnya

tips.name: Feaulle H570
tips.review: Wide and flat. It makes the upper mids clear, with less bass of course. An alternative to the Azla Sedna EarFit Short and Softears UC. Really suits the Tin HiFi C3.
tips.original: Lebar ceper. bikin upper mids jelas. less bass tentu saja. alternative dari azla sednaearfit short dan softears UC. cocok bangets buat tin hifi C3

tips.name: Spinfit Neo
tips.review: Very comfortable in the ear. Comes with nozzle extensions for IEMs with short nozzles. The sound is WARM, that's it, but the bass doesn't get much bigger. More or less like Final Type E: the kind that warms the treble. Suits the C3 MK II.
tips.original: Sangat nyaman di telinga. dapet nozzle extension juga buat iem yang nozzlenya pendek bisa ditambahin itu. suaranya WARM. that's it tapi bassnya gak nambah jadi guede. kurang lebih arahnya kaya final type e lah. tipe2 yang bikin warm treble. cocok digunakan buat C3 mark ii

tips.name: Spinfit W1
tips.review: Good clarity, good midrange. The shape is a bit stiffer, not as soft as the CP145. A wide bore, so the upper mids/treble come out bright and clear. But the tube is a bit long. I use it on the Chu 2, whose nozzle is fairly long: a good match, with the soundstage well preserved.
tips.original: Clarity bagus. midrange bagus. bentuknya agak keras ga selemes cp145. dia lebar borenya. makanya upper mids/treblenya terang jelas. tapi agak panjang nozzlenya. gw pake di chu 2 yang nozzlenya agak lumayan panjang dikit. cocok. soundstagenya terjaga baik

tips.name: Dunu Stage & Studio
tips.review: Adds upper mids/treble. The fit is very OK, surprisingly nice despite the super unique shape. The soundstage stays well preserved. I still prefer AET08 for soundstage.
tips.original: Nambah Upper mids/Treble. fitingnya oke banget. surprisingly nice fitting walau bentuknya super unik. soundstage tetep terjaga dengan baik. Masi prefer AET08 kalo soal soundstage

tips.name: Azla Sedna Earfit Short
tips.review: Works on the Soundcore Liberty 3 Pro and fits in the case. Insanely nice: excellent fit and resolution. Also suits the KZ ESX: great, thick midrange that opens up. Nice.
tips.original:
Bisa dipakai di soundcore liberty 3 pro. muat di case. enak parah. fitting dan resolusi mantap. 
dipake di KZ ESX jg cocok.. midrange ajib. tebel. midrange jadi kebuka. enak.

tips.name: Final Audio Type E
tips.review: Use this if you want your IEM to sound bassier. The treble doesn't attack, and the mids get a little less revealing, but it's so fun to use, I swear: pleasant and exciting. Also suits cheap IEMs like the TRN MT1 Max, Salnotes Zero and KZ DFi.
tips.original:
Ini dipakai kalo lu pengen bikin suara IEM lu jadi makin ngebass.  treble gak nyerang.. Midsnya jadi kurang revealing sedikit. tapi fun banget sumpah pakai ini tuh. Enak dan seru. Tapi sekarang ... 
Cocok juga di IEM murah kaya TRN MT1 Max, Salnotes Zero, KZ D-FI

tips.name: Tangzu Sancai
tips.review: Warms things up. I use it on the Sennheiser MTW3 and Liberty 3 Pro TWS and they fit the cases; there's a Sancai-specific EQ in the TWS section of the book. The material is like medical equipment in hospitals. A fairly wide bore that preserves the midrange well. It has a crumbly texture but is super comfortable on my MTW3. I haven't yet found an IEM it suits.
tips.original: Bikin warm. gw pake di TWS Sennheiser MTW3 dan Liberty 3 pro masuk. dan ada EQ khusus Sancai di kitab TWS. bahannya seperti medical yang ada d peralatan rumasakit. bore agak lebar. ngejaga midrange baik. berteksture crumble gitu tapi super nyaman banget gw pake di MTW 3. di IEM belum coba yang cocok dimana

tips.name: Xelastec Sedna
tips.review: Use this if you want to reduce bass and add treble. Annoyingly the soundstage shrinks a bit because the tip is a bit too short for my taste. But it's one of the ones with a really good fit, and it shortens the distance from tip to ear if you need that for an IEM with a too-long nozzle. The material is cool: the more you use it, the more it remembers the shape of your ear canal.
tips.original: Ini bisa lu pakai kalo lu pengen ngurangin bass dan nambain treble. Sialnya sih soundstagenya agak jadi berkurang karena tinggi eartipsnya agak kependekan menurut gw. tapi ini salah satu yang fittingnnya juga oke banget. buat ngeshorten jarak eartips ke telinga if u need that for your IEM yang nozzlenya kepanjang maybe. dan bahannnya keren gitu. kalo lu semakin sering pake. dia bakal mengingat bentuk buletan telinga lu

tips.name: Dekoni Mercury Foam
tips.review: I use this for PLANARS only, to extremely tame a bright IEM or spicy treble. Keep in mind foam feels different and the seal gets very, very tight. Nice that it's washable, though foam doesn't last as long as silicone. But it's really nice on my Tin HiFi P1 and Shuoer S12.
tips.original: I use this for PLANARS only. buat extremely nge tame down IEM bright or trebelnya pedes. tapi keep in mind memang rasanya agak beda pakai foam dan congenya nempelnya makin makin banget. enaknya bisa dicuci. cuma usia foam ga sepanjang usia silicone sih. tapi ini enak baget dipake di Tin Hifi P1 dan Shuoer s12 gw

tips.name: Monoprice
tips.review: One of the champion most comfortable eartips; it feels like you're not wearing eartips at all, lol. Soft and light somehow. Enjoyable. It adds bass, but not too punchy or anything.
tips.original: Salah satu jawara Eartips yang paling nyaman yang rasanya kaya kaga pakai eartips dah wkwkwk. lembek2 ringan gimana gitu.. asyik. nambah bassnya dapet.. tapi gak terlalu puncy or gimana

tips.name: Final Audio Fusion G
tips.review: Suits the XM5 because the material is similar, hybrid silicone and foam, but thinner and more elastic than Sony's stock XM5 tips. A bit more open with slightly less bass. Fits verrry nicely on the XM5 without sacrificing ANC performance.
tips.original: Cocok untuk XM5. karena bahannya agak setipe. hybrid silicone dan foam. tapi lebih tipis dan elastis daripada bawaan XM5 Sony. lebih open dan less bass dikit. fit verrrryy nicely with XM5 without sacrificing ANC performance

tips.name: Ortofon
tips.review: Also one of the lightest, with champion comfort. The bass may not be very punchy, a bit soft and boomy, but not a problem. Try it; it's really nice.
tips.original: Ini juga salah satu yang paling ringan dan comfortnya juara. tapi mungkin bassnya juga gak terlalu punchy amat sih kaya lembek2 boomy.. but not a problem. cobain deh. ini rnak banget

tips.name: Acoustune AEX07
tips.review: Also an enjoyable eartip: it trims the very top of the treble a little, while the upper mids and mids become enjoyably transparent. Good for vocals, and it reduces sub-bass slightly. The fit is nicer than Acoustune AET08, and it sounds lovely too.
tips.original: Eartips yang asyik juga ini ngurangin treble yang ujung dikit. tapi upper mids dan midsnya jadi asyik transparan. cocok buat vokalan dan agak ngurangin sub bass sedikit. fitting juga lebih enak dari acoustune AET08. dan suaranya juga cakep..

tips.name: Divinus Velvet
tips.review: Smooth and warm. A nice fit. Still energetic even though it's a bit warm. The fit is slightly nicer than AET08.
tips.original: Smooth and warm. fittingnya enak. tetep energik walau agak warm dikit. fitting agak lebih enak dari aet08

tips.name: Final Audio Type E for TWS
tips.review: Wow, this is crazy good for TWS: on the Edifier NeoBuds Pro and the WF-1000XM4 too. The bass gets punchy and the upper mids bright. The best TWS eartips in my view. I've also tried them on the ATH-CKS50TW: really enjoyable. Nice fit, nice sound.
tips.original: wah ini gokil asliii enak banget buat TWS. di Edifier neobuds pro, di WF-1000xm4 juga sabi banget.. bassnya jadi punchy. uppermids nya jadi terang... ini eartips TWS paling baik menurut gw. udah gw coba juga di ATH CKS50TW juga asyik banget.. fitting asyik. suara juga asyik.

tips.name: Azla Sedna Earfit Light
tips.review: One of the wide-bore eartips, which means it brightens the upper mids/treble a little. Usually the soundstage shrinks a bit, but since its tube is fairly long it doesn't shrink as much as Xelastec. Nice, enjoyable fit. I mostly use it on the Tin HiFi T3+, so the bass isn't too much. Nice on a single DD you feel has too much bass. One person complained it made their ears itch, but not me.
tips.original: Ini salah satu eartip yang Bore-nya lebar. which means bikin bright sedikit di upper mids/treble. biasanya agak berkurang soundstagenya. tapi karena dia tabungnya agak panjang. jadi tidak terlalu berkurang kaya Xelastec. enak fitting asyik. terus mostly gw pakai ini di Tin Hifi T3+ jadi pas aja bassnya gak kebanyakan. enaklah di Single DD yang lu rasa kebanyakan bassnya juga enak. ada 1 orang mengeluhkan ini bikin gatel tp di gw sih engak

tips.name: Acoustune AEX70
tips.review: Good soundstage, focused on treble clarity. The material is a bit thin. The fit is decent but lacks grip; if you want a lot of grip, try Dunu S&S, or Softears UC if you want a "full" feeling in the ear.
tips.original: Good soundstage fokus treble clarity. bahannnya agak tipis.. fittingnya lumayan. tapi kurang grip kalo nyari grip banget bisa dunu S&S, or softears UC kalo mau ada rasa "Penuh" di telinga

tips.name: Dunu Candy
tips.review: Adds a little treble extension at the top, not in the upper midrange. Well-controlled bass. Its only weakness: a bit hard to put on.
tips.original: Added treble extension sedikit di ujung bukan di upper midrange. well controlled bass. cuma kekurangannya masukinnnya agak susah.

tips.name: Pentacon Coreir
tips.review: Don't. A waste: overpriced for eartips. It brightens things. Only suits short nozzles; when it fits, it fits really well and can make things better or warmer, like on my Letshuoer EJ07M. On long nozzles it catches on its brass part. I gave it a C for value because it's such a waste: very expensive. Just a shame.
tips.original: jangan deh. sayang. overpriced beli earitps harga segini. bikin bright. cuma cocok di nozzle Pendek. kalo pas ya cocok banget. bisa better bisa warm. kaya di Letshuoer ej07m gw cocok. kalo nozzle2 panjang dia nyangkut. di bahan brassnya itu. valuenya gw taro C karena sayang banget. muahal banget. kaya gimana gitu sayang aja.

tips.name: Spinfit CP145
tips.review: This is just safe, kind of neutral; I don't feel anything. It does the job well as an eartip, but has no particular character. Its headline feature is supposedly that it rotates comfortably to adjust the IEM's position.
tips.original: ini aman aja kaya netral2 aja gw ga ngerasa apa2. jadi ya does the job well aja sebagai eartips tapi gak ada karakter2 gimana gitu. fitur andalannnya katanya sih nyaman diputer2gitu buat adjust posisi IEM

tips.name: Tri clarion
tips.review: A standard wide bore. Brightens things. But it's cheap.
tips.original: ya standar wide bore. bikin bright. tapi harganya murah

tips.name: Acoustune AEX50
tips.review: Works on the Soundcore Dot 3i. It has wings, adding a little soundstage and midrange clarity. The wings feel a bit odd at first, but it fits in the case. If you need tips for a Dot 3i, go for it.
tips.original: bisa buat soundcore dot3i. ada sayapnya.. nambah soundstage dan midrange clarity dikit. agak anek emang ada sayapnya awal2. tapi muat masuk casingnya. buat yang butuh buat dot3i sikat

tips.name: Dekoni Bulletz for TWS (foam)
tips.review: Great for TWS if you want a smooth, less aggressive sound. I use it on the Sony WF-1000XM4, not because its highs are harsh, but because it's just really nice and smooth.
tips.original: Cucok buat TWS banget yang  pengen suaranya smooth, less aggressive. gw pake ini di Sony wf-1000xm4 bukan karena high nya itu harsh yaa.. tapi karena, gapap enak banget aja jadi smooth.
